description: This file implements a certificate path builder for SSL/TLS certificate validation, including path discovery, issuer selection, and trust evaluation.

classes.name: IssuerEntry
classes.description: Represents a certificate issuer along with trust level and match order.

classes.name: CertIssuersIter
classes.description: Iterates through potential issuer certificates from sources, supporting synchronous and asynchronous retrieval, and prioritization.

classes.name: CertIssuerIterPath
classes.description: Tracks certificates in the current path to prevent duplicates and cycles.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderResultPath
classes.description: Represents a discovered certificate path with trust info and validation status.

classes.name: CertPathIter
classes.description: Generates possible certificate paths from a target cert to a trust anchor, handling backtracking and path constraints.

classes.name: CertPathBuilder
classes.description: Main class orchestrating path discovery, verification, and result management for certificate validation.

methods.name: FingerPrintParsedCertificate
methods.description: Computes a hex-encoded SHA-256 fingerprint of a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: CertDebugString
methods.description: Generates a debug string for a certificate including fingerprint and subject.

methods.name: PathDebugString
methods.description: Creates a debug string for a list of certificates.

methods.name: GetNextIssuer
methods.description: Retrieves the next candidate issuer certificate from sources.

methods.name: AddIssuers
methods.description: Adds new issuer certificates to the candidate list, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: SortRemainingIssuers
methods.description: Sorts issuer candidates based on trust and key identifiers for prioritization.

methods.name: GetNextPath
methods.description: Generates the next possible certificate path, handling backtracking, depth, and iteration limits.

methods.name: AddResultPath
methods.description: Stores a discovered path result, updating the best path based on validity and trust.
